title: eludite.update.check input
description: Read the channel's release list from GitHub (one conditional request; a 304 costs nothing against the rate limit) and say whether a newer build exists (Help > Check for Updates). `download: true` also downloads, verifies and stages it, as the `download` mode's timer does. Refused for a development build (the output says so, `enabled: false`).

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the result, in milliseconds (0 to 600000). 0: answer at once with the state so far (`busy` says it is still running; read eludite.update.status later). The UI passes 0; an agent that wants the answer passes a few seconds.
